messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up — Jonah's birthday is Fri Aug 13. Quick poll: react with :one: office tea + biscotti 4pm, :two: ship mini herb kits to remote folks, or :three: e-card + team Spotify playlist. Reply with allergies/preferences.
harriet (People Ops): We can combine tea + kits for in-office folks. Need headcount for GF/dairy-free. Deadline Wed 5pm.
jonah: surprise me! herb kits are fun though, esp for my sad basil. no candles pls.
brie: :two: love the herb kit idea. happy to help assemble if needed.
samir: :one: if people are local. i'll bring decaf.
ivy: :three: remote here, playlist please. also allergic to sesame.
harriet (People Ops): noted sesame. form: https://forms.gle/jonah-bday-poll — pick 1/2/3 and list dietary notes + shipping address if remote.
brie: i'll volunteer to assemble kits and label GF where needed.
people-ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Jonah birthday — tea & kits". Calendar invite will be sent if option 1 wins.
harriet (People Ops): final reminder — fill the form by Wed 5pm. we'll include a handwritten card from the team. please keep replies short to avoid channel clutter.
